title: Residence on c. 17.5 Acres of Land, St. Jude's, Sherlockstown Common, Sallins, Co. Kildare, W91 X4K4
seoTitle: Residence on c. 17.5 Acres of Land, St. Jude's, Sherlockstown Common, Sallins, Co. Kildare, W91 X4K4
description:
DNG are delighted to present St. Jude's, a country home, comprising of a detached dormer bungalow extending to approximately c.195 sq. m. (c. 2098 sq. ft) and set amidst an impressive c. 17.5 acres of land (c. 7.082 Hectares) laid out in 4 divisions. The property requires modernisation, offering the discerning purchaser an exciting opportunity to create a home tailored to their own tastes and requirements.Nestled within a tranquil and picturesque countryside setting, this family home enjoys magnificent panoramic views across Sherlockstown. The property is further complemented by a detached garage, carport and gardens, c.17.5 acres of land (c. 7.082 Hectares) and benefits from an extensive range of ancillary buildings and equestrian facilities, including a dedicated boiler house, two existing stables, a selection of useful sheds, an additional yard incorporating a further six stables. There is also direct access to the surrounding fields, offering excellent versatility for equestrian, agricultural or hobby-farming purposes.With its generous acreage, stunning surroundings and excellent potential, this is a truly special property that offers a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial family home in a peaceful yet highly accessible setting.Internally, the property briefly comprises, entrance hall leading to the main hallway, living room, sunroom, open-plan kitchen/breakfast room, dining room,  utility room, four bedrooms, two en-suite and main family bathroom. The landing upstairs gives access to balcony and fantastic views.  The kitchen/breakfast area provides an excellent heart to the home, creating a bright and versatile space from which to enjoy the surrounding views and gardens. Externally, the property is equally impressive. The mature gardens provide an abundance of private parking and a wonderful sense of space and seclusion. The detached garage and carport provide excellent additional storage and parking facilities, while mature trees, established planting enhance the privacy and appeal of the property.The property enjoys an enviable location, combining excellent connectivity with the convenience of a host of established towns and amenities close by. The M7 motorway is readily accessible, providing swift connections to Dublin City Centre and the wider national road network, while the thriving towns of Sallins, Naas and Straffan are all within easy reach. Together, they offer an impressive selection of shopping, dining, sporting and leisure facilities to suit every need.For commuters, Sallins benefits from an Arrow rail service, providing regular and convenient connections to Dublin. Golf enthusiasts are particularly well catered for, with the renowned K Club, Palmerstown House Estate and Naas Golf Club all just a short drive away, alongside a wealth of other sporting and recreational facilities in the surrounding area.The location is ideally suited to family life, with an excellent choice of primary and secondary schools nearby, including several highly regarded private schools. Everyday conveniences are equally well provided for, with supermarkets, shops, creches, churches, restaurants, cafés, bars and boutiques all within easy reach.St. Jude's represents a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial detached family home in a peaceful and private setting. With its spectacular views, generous accommodation, mature gardens and superb location, this is a home that truly offers the best of countryside living without compromising on convenience.Viewing is highly recommended.By Public Auction:

Wednesday 14th October 2026 at 3pm 
in Lawlors of Naas Hotel, Popular Square, Naas, Co. Kildare W91Y65NSolicitor: Mr David Osborne, Osborne Denieffe Solicitors
